translations.web: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
translations.bsb: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
translations.kjv: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
translations.asv: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.
